name: Nutanix

page_total_how: Playwright render of https://careers.nutanix.com/en/jobs/ (no filters): 'Displaying 1 to 20 of 283 matching jobs'. The XML feed has 425 <job> rows = 283 unique <requisitionid> (one row per location; extra rows have ids like 'olyvAfwI-Cr5lVfww'), and the site's job ids are those requisition ids (/en/jobs/32891/... = <requisitionid>32891).

notes: No shared Jobvite adapter exists; the XML feed is a single GET, so a small shared 'jobvite' adapter is easy (see note). Both interns have jobtype 'Evergreen' (not 'Internship'), which is why the bookmark's type=Internship filter shows no results. The checker does not need careers.nutanix.com.
